notes.title: Releasing a demo version of Air Fleet!
notes.content:
Good afternoon, fans of airplanes, flying and everything related to it. 
We open access to the demo version of our new game Air Fleet, so you can enjoy controlling the airline and lay routes to different cities.

Game Trailer
https://youtu.be/9gcdilGfHmw

Airfleet - your own airline is in your hands! Manage every aspect of the business: from thoughtful route planning to accurate crew selection, every decision affects your company's reputation and efficiency.

Download the demo version now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2565230/Air_Fleet_Demo/

We wish you a pleasant game and look forward to your feedback!

notes.title: "Hard Choices" Update
notes.content:
Hey, everybody!

In this article, we will talk about the update and new mechanics.

Hard Choices
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046280/18f558cef0386ad2da714c8bd87bab88d14fab71.png
We continue to improve and develop the story mode in the game. You now have the opportunity to answer some emails, which will lead to various plot developments!

Decorative plants and flowers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046280/ce8c4fc2856e37491a1bcca820cb4ea61e2c6219.jpg

FOV customization
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046280/69d0bad9395835842b85e2fb117bbd26961ccc24.png
Some players asked us to add this setting, and we granted their wish.

Fixes
-Improved German translation. Thanks to a person called Launemax
-Corrected the appearance of interior elements in the asphalt
-Corrected mouse behavior at low FPS or statters

notes.title: "New Faces" Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have released an update called “New Faces”. Let's find out what's new!
New skins for NPCs
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046280/5ac0baeedce44aa4e6b097e62b93a4143d1844f9.png
These are the very “new faces”. We decided to diversify the appearance of our NPCs by increasing the number of looks.
Fixes:
-Fixed bugs that caused the queue of customers to get stuck, making it impossible to serve them.
-Fixed game crashes related to knockout after a fight and the box recycler.
-Fixed a bug that caused the story to interrupt if the player chose to stay with a friend in the restaurant.
-Fixed typos in text.
-Fixed a bug with phantom dirt that caused customers to put bad reviews.
-Fixed display of the list of keys for combat in some situations.
-Fixed a bug because of which some skills did not work when restarting the game.

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

In this article, we will tell you about the fixes in today's hotfix.
Fixes:
-Increased the amount of stamina spent per hit
-Lowered the threshold for blocking punches, you will now be able to block after a series of punches
-The player's health has been increased from 4 to 5 units
-The chance of blocking a blow from NPCs has been reduced from 50% to 25%.
-Corrected bonuses from some interior elements
-Corrected a bug due to which the morning delivery of goods did not occur, resulting in phantom orders

notes.title: New Drunkards event and fixes
notes.content:
Hey, everybody!

In this news we will tell you about the new update.

Drunkards:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046280/fee2eba23161b9df91d12d8d91a38fe9e9a55d6c.png
Drunks will come at random times and swear at everyone, causing customers to downgrade their reviews. So you will have to “force them out”.

Corrections:
-Fixed the scaling of some UI elements that were out of their limits.
-Added a modern fitting room bonus. Customers will now spend less time trying on clothes.

notes.title: Plans for game development and hotfixes!
notes.content:
Hey, everybody!

Today we want to show you our plan to develop our game in future updates
Roadmap:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046280/79f3872f2085a896b78e95ca9c75c0584073adb8.png

In addition to this, we have released 3 hotfixes since release.
What we've fixed:
-Corrected the height of the bottom of modern shelves, now there will be no dirt there and reduced feedback for boxes lying on the floor.
-Fixed save bugs that led to random appearance of interior elements on the map, as well as breaking the story.
-Fixed that when hitting a customer standing in a queue, the rest of the queue would stand still and not be able to move on.

notes.title: New interior, collaborations, optimization and save system!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, today we'll tell you what's new in our project and preparations for the soon release.

Interior
First of all, we have added more different interior elements, with which, you can decorate your pickup point and get various bonuses!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046280/db034cd28c48ce7c9b1f517fab6e7be4ff44ff84.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046280/df01fa1907780cee586aa4cf6ce80947a7674786.jpg
In addition, based on feedback from the demo, we've improved the building system itself, adding the ability to cancel interior moves, sales, and wall and ceiling installations.

Collaborations
One of the new mechanics added is the collaboration system.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046280/0de021d9219c91c19384f1cd2fa380cf09d0c911.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046280/099d75e0c51cda896b6af609325aeb1318aac4d7.png
Collaborations open up new opportunities for the player in the form of various bonuses and new builds. You can only have 2 active collaborations at a time, so the player will have to choose wisely based on the current situation.

Smaller innovations, but no less important
In addition to everything else, the game was added a save system, Steam cloud was connected, some parts of the code were rewritten to eliminate microfreezes and bugs were fixed.

Release is very close
The game is only 19 days away from release(August 12), but we continue to work and improve our game every day in pursuit of release! If you want to support Pickup Point Simulator, you can add it to your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2316030/Pickup_Point_Simulator/

notes.title: Demo update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We have released a new update for our demo version, here is the list of changes:


 Fixed the bug with mud feedback. We have completely reworked the system of mud spawn in the Pickup Point, now it will not be able to spawn under the interior, boxes or even on the characters because of what many players could not notice it.
 Fixed the position of the mop. Now it will be in the center at the time of installation.
 Improved tutorial. Added a section that shows where to expand the Pickup Point, purchase new licenses and change the signage.
 Changed the icon of the buttons on the licenses for better readability.
.

Thanks to everyone who played the demo version and shared their impressions! We continue to improve and refine our game on a daily basis.
